proposition: In the Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr Ibn Turka rewrites Ibn al-Fāriḍ's line 619 to give ‘children and the holy Imams’ for ‘Companions and Followers’ and reads the second weighty thing of the ḥadīth al-thaqalayn as the ʿitra, yet still credits Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān and gives ʿAlī the highest praise.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka in his own doctrinal work, as summarised by MK
mediation.where: MS Majlis 10196 and other manuscripts as cited by MK

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
